findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: a keyboard user on Settings (h1 focused on open) reaches ← Home with Tab. Actual: in Chromium the first Tab from the focused heading moves focus out of the page, because ← Home precedes the h1 and is the only control. A second Tab wraps back to ← Home, and Shift+Tab reaches it directly. WebKit (Alt+Tab) reaches it in one press. This is the same layout as Statistics (A-3), so it is not blocking.
findings.fix: Optional: none required for this slice. Later Settings controls placed after the heading will make Tab reach a control directly.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: the v3-upgrade unit test proves that the upgrade writes the default record. Actual: it checks only through readSettings(), which also returns the defaults when no record exists, so a regression that skips the put on upgrade would not fail it. The product behaviour itself is correct: the raw record is present after upgrade, confirmed in fake-indexeddb and in real Chromium/WebKit profiles.
findings.fix: Optional: also read the raw value at key 'settings' in the upgraded DB and assert it equals the defaults.
